body:
A human selects one or more elements of an open design by clicking them, so a note can point at them later (feature:afd9fe8bae36c59c). Selection is by element ID.

### Do

- Outside the click-through preview, clicking a drawn element selects it by its `data-design-id`. In preview a click still follows links, as now.
- A human can select more than one element, and clear the selection.
- Selection is lost when another design, tab or version is opened, or when a live reload removes a selected element.
- Keep the selected IDs in the page model where the panel and direct editing can read them later (feature:c3bed08cc1bbbbb8).

Ask the human how a selected element is shown, how more than one is selected, and how a selection is cleared.

### Acceptance

- Tests: a click selects the right ID, a nested element selects itself and not its parent, preview clicks still navigate, and opening another design clears the selection.
- Update the README.

### Left out

Regions, the Architecture tab, and sending a note.
title: notes: select elements by clicking
